tools.name: get_advisory
tools.description: A Red Hat RHSA or Microsoft KB or ADV with its CVEs and records.

tools.name: get_vendor
tools.description: A vendor's records, highest priority first. Takes the same filters as search_vulnerabilities.

tools.name: get_vulnerability
tools.description: A record for a TI id or an alias such as a CVE or GHSA id. Merged ids give the surviving record. By default the record is shortened: no CPE matches, at most 20 references (exploits and patches first) and the 10 newest advisories; trimmed says what was cut.

tools.name: list_exploited
tools.description: Recent additions to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalogue. Newest first, each with its Threatist record.

tools.name: search_vulnerabilities
tools.description: Records matching a text and filters, a page at a time. Pass next as cursor for the next page.
